caseNameFull: Malory v. McGettrick, Sheriff of Cuyahoga County, Ohio
attorneys: Walter S. Haffner for petitioner. John T. Cor-rigan and Harvey R. Monck for respondent. T. W. Bruton, Attorney General of North Carolina, and Ralph Moody, Assistant Attorney General, for the State of North Carolina, as .amicus curiae, in opposition. Norman Leonard for the National Lawyers Guild, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition. Melvin L. Wulf and Ralph Rudd for the American Civil Liberties Union et al., as amici curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Motion of the National Lawyers Guild for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Motion of the American Civil Liberties Union et al. for leave to file a brief, as amici curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio denied.
